title: Advanced Electrical: Switch, Light, and Troubleshooting
markdown:
# RCS Day 5 - Advanced Electrical: Switch, Light, and Troubleshooting
CTS Cohort 6 | CTS Day 13 | 2026-07-27 | 10:00 AM-3:00 PM

## Core rule
A professional does not guess. A professional checks, protects, and verifies.

## Big idea
Troubleshooting is disciplined evidence gathering: verify the source state, follow the path, find the first failed checkpoint, correct one issue, and retest.

## Architecture of the day
| Time | Instructor move |
|---|---|
| 10:00-10:15 | Arrival, PPE, retrieval warm-up |
| 10:15-10:30 | Morning quiz |
| 10:30-10:50 | Quiz review and energy-boundary check |
| 10:50-11:20 | Switch-controlled lighting path model |
| 11:20-12:00 | Splice, pigtail, and termination demonstration |
| 12:00-12:30 | Troubleshooting ladder guided practice and lab release |
| 12:30-1:00 | Lunch and controlled reset |
| 1:00-2:25 | Switch/light install and inserted-fault lab |
| 2:25-2:45 | Correction, retest, evidence, cleanup |
| 2:45-3:00 | Exit ticket and Day 6 preview |

## Learning targets
- Trace a de-energized switch-controlled lighting path
- Install a training switch and light outlet box
- Use visual inspection and continuity to diagnose inserted faults
- Document the fault, evidence, correction, and retest

## Materials and setup
- Six isolated switch/light training stations
- Switch boxes, light outlet boxes, training switches, light points, cable, and pigtail materials
- Approved line-switch-load-neutral diagrams
- Meters reserved for isolated continuity testing
- Instructor-only fault cards and reset controls
- PPE, labels, hand tools, and evidence devices

## Instructor talking points
- Retrieve PV101 Day 6 hidden-fuse troubleshooting logic and apply it to residential training circuits.
- Trace line -> switch -> load -> neutral return and the separate grounding path.
- Model safe splice preparation, pigtails, box fill awareness, labeling, and device orientation at training level.
- Demonstrate the troubleshooting ladder with no energized student work.
- Connect all work to the capstone requirement: two outlets, one switch, and one light point.
